486:t_015:9.en:
$$ジン$$
「Impossible... Gathering 12,000 years' worth of feelings isn't that easy...」

486:t_015:12.en:
$$不動$$
「You yourselves have come through 12,000 years, and now you're about to advance to a new stage.」

486:t_015:23.en:
$$不動$$
「Now is the time to show it.」

486:t_015:24.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「But even so, you cannot dispel the darkness.」

486:t_015:25.en:
$$ズール$$
「The stronger the light, the deeper the darkness grows.」

486:t_015:26.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Love and hatred are two sides of the same coin...」

486:t_015:27.en:
$n
「It's just like... the $$いがみ合う双子$$...」

486:t_015:29.en:
$$ダリー$$
「Don't talk as though twins were on bad terms!」

486:t_015:32.en:
$$タケル$$
「Light and darkness... They're just like twins...」

486:t_016:0.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Let's do it, everyone! We'll unite all of our feelings and gather them into $$ソーラーアクエリオン$$!」

486:t_016:1.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Hope, courage, love, justice... The positive feelings humans have...」

486:t_016:2.en:
$$カグラ$$
「With those, they've got to become the light that dispels this darkness!」

486:t_017:1.en:
$$タケル$$
「Light doesn't erase darkness... Beyond light and darkness...」

486:t_017:2.en:
$$勝平$$
「Watch this, $$コンピュータードール#pilot$$! I'll show you the light of humanity that dispels the darkness!」

486:t_017:4.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Uoooooh! Answer me, $$アクエリオン$$!!」

486:t_018:1.en:
$$タケル$$
(We have hearts that love so that we can overcome hatred... Hope is born because we stand up to despair...)

486:t_018:2.en:
$$タケル$$
(Light and darkness are both the human heart... Humans can't exist with only one of the two...)

486:t_018:3.en:
$$タケル$$
(So we shouldn't deny the darkness. We have to accept the darkness.)

486:t_019:1.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Was the one with $$タケル$$ his big brother $$マーグ$$...!?」

486:t_019:2.en:
$$タケル$$
「So all of you felt my brother too.」

486:t_019:4.en:
$$万丈$$
「And now I understand. What we're meant to do.」

486:t_019:5.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Heh... All I ever did was smash villains, so I never once thought about what darkness means.」

486:t_019:6.en:
$$アマタ$$
「I remember now! We... we were supposed to have learned that!」

486:t_019:9.en:
$$シュレード$$
「Death is not something to fear.」

486:t_019:10.en:
$$カイエン$$
「Right... If this is the world of the dead, the souls of the people precious to us might be here too.」

486:t_019:17.en:
$$タケル$$
「Because those people were here, we are here now...」

486:t_019:18.en:
$$タケル$$
「We'll accept the darkness and make it our strength too!」

486:t_020:1.en:
$$カヲル$$
「Now that the world's balance has been preserved, they've gone back to where they belong.」

486:t_020:2.en:
$$シモン$$
「What is this feeling...! It's my first time, but somehow it feels familiar!」

486:t_020:3.en:
$$葵$$
「Even in a space this dark and cold, I can feel strength welling up...!」

486:t_020:4.en:
$$万丈$$
「Precisely because we know the darkness, we can feel the light all the more...」

486:t_020:5.en:
$$不動$$
「Where there is light, there is darkness... Where there is darkness, there is light...」

486:t_020:6.en:
$$不動$$
「Knowing yin, you understand the meaning of yang. That is the yang of $$太極$$... in other words, the sun!」

486:t_020:9.en:
$$ズール$$
「To think they would find light in the darkness!」

486:t_020:10.en:
$$タケル$$
「$$ズール$$! Now I'll show you the true power you feared - mine... ours!」

486:t_021:0.en:
$$ズール$$
「$$マーズ$$! I sense $$マーグ$$ in there!」

486:t_022:1.en:
$$タケル$$
「$$正太郎$$! Get $$鉄人$$ back while we have the chance!」

486:t_022:3.en:
$$タケル$$
「What's interfering with it is the malice of $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$. So it should be possible to move $$鉄人$$ with your feelings, too.」

486:t_022:4.en:
$$タケル$$
「Remember. When you defeated $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$, $$鉄人$$ came back to you even though you weren't steering with the $$Ｖコン$$.」

486:t_022:6.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「I won't let you! $$鉄人$$, bend to my will!」

486:t_023:2.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「$$鉄人$$! You too shall become part of my forces!」
